channel_hint.description: Where the one-time code was sent; never the destination itself
channel_hint.title: Channel Hint

ChargeView.description:
Verified fields of one charge, as the tools read them (get_transaction, list_recent_transactions, and the
masked card list of get_customer_profile). Nothing here is model text; a field the data lacks is null.

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of that card, from the masked profile
card_last4.title: Card Last4

card_type.description: Credit Card or Debit Card when the charge moved a card
card_type.title: Card Type

category.description: Transaction category: Food, Transport, Services, Entertainment, Health or Other
category.title: Category

channel.description: ATM, Branch, Web, App, POS or Transfer
channel.title: Channel

transaction_date.description: Local time of the transaction, no offset
transaction_date.title: Transaction Date

ChargeView.title: ChargeView

deadline.description: Last day to file, computed by the policy engine from the charge date
deadline.title: Deadline

rule_id.description: Window rule of agent/policy/rules.yaml, e.g. MX-WINDOW-001
rule_id.title: Rule Id

charge.description: The charge a dispute confirmation is about; null for a card

review.description: True when policy sends the registered case to human review
review.title: Review

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. session_expired, otp_invalid, rate_limited
code.title: Code

cost_usd.description: null when a price is unknown
cost_usd.title: Cost Usd

MatchReason.description:
Why a charge matched the description: one ranker feature that fired, with a label in the conversation
language. `value` is the number in the label (percent or days), when it has one.
MatchReason.title: MatchReason

reasons.description: Match reasons that fired; empty for cards or when none fired
reasons.title: Reasons

code.description: Demo mode only: the code the mock channel delivered for this challenge
code.title: Code

RecognitionView.description: The "do you recognize it?" step, before any confirmation is issued.
RecognitionView.title: RecognitionView

recognized.description: True: the customer recognizes the charge and no dispute is opened
recognized.title: Recognized

expires_at.description: On the service clock (see GET /health service_clock)
expires_at.title: Expires At

expires_in.description: Seconds until expires_at, so a client does not depend on clock agreement
expires_in.title: Expires In

session_token.description: Send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Expires in 15 minutes.
session_token.title: Session Token

language.description: Fixed for the conversation on its first turn
language.title: Language

info.description: Transaction-dispute intake: session gate, conversation, confirmation, handoff queue and audit trace. Synthetic data only.
info.title: Cautela API
